The CreateBankAccount mutation response object $.data.createBankAccount (id present, shape-a2d2c53037a48c732a4d04fe) is proposed as the added member of the list observed after the write: the before read returns one list member and the after read returns two (collection_count fact), whose visible '-1' member is the configured-'Alpha Bank' row added by ui-diff-0002, and the recorded userId value movement request:0 -> request:4 binds the new member to the same account.

The create request:4 response carries a single created object at $.data.createBankAccount (id/uuid/bankName/...), and the collection $.data.listBankAccount grew by exactly one ($.data.listBankAccount 1→2, signed_delta +1) while ui-diff-0002 shows one new account row ('Alpha Bank'). The identity field pair member $.id ↔ collection item $.id and the member path are frozen hypotheses; no member_identity_state_evidence or locator witness was recorded, so the member-level attribution is proposed, not proven.

The create mutation response exposes one created account object at $.data.createBankAccount (id, uuid, bankName ... in shape-a2d2c53037a48c732a4d04fe) and the follow-up ListBankAccount read request:6 returns the same account collection shape; the member identity is the created resource id, checked as a strict tuple against the collection member id in the before/after list reads.
